name: prometheus
description: The Prometheus monitoring system and time series database.
one_liner: A tool that watches your servers and apps around the clock and can sound an alarm the moment something breaks.
buyer: An independent IT consultant managing servers for several small businesses who needs one dashboard to catch outages before a customer notices.
business_use_cases: An MSP offers 'we monitor your servers 24/7' as a monthly add-on service built on Prometheus plus alerting.
A DevOps freelancer sets up Prometheus dashboards for small SaaS clients as a one-off engagement, then sells an ongoing tuning retainer.
A vertical SaaS (e.g. for restaurant point-of-sale systems) embeds Prometheus internally and resells 'uptime monitoring' as a customer-facing feature.

money_ideas.idea: Monthly managed-monitoring service for small-business servers
One-time dashboard and alerting setup project

steal_this: Offer three local small businesses a 'we'll watch your website so it doesn't go down without you knowing' monthly service, powered by a Prometheus instance you manage for them.
